name: Sri Lakshmi Saraswathi Textiles Arni Ltd-$

facts.business: Sri Lakshmi Saraswathi Textiles (Arni) Limited is engaged in the textile manufacturing business.

auditor.name: M/s S Viswanathan LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: 1. Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern: The Company's net worth has been completely eroded with accumulated losses of Rs.10,514.05 lakhs and net losses for three consecutive years. 2. Non-Receipt of Confirmations: Outstanding balances for Advances Made (Rs.395.57 lakhs), Advances Received (Rs.93.09 lakhs), Trade Receivables (Rs.75.05 lakhs), and Trade Payables (Rs.3,350.77 lakhs) lack confirmations; Trade Payables confirmations received for Rs.1,116.45 lakhs show unreconciled difference of Rs.3.40 lakhs. 3. Non-Remittance of Statutory Dues: Outstanding ESI (Rs.10.42 lakhs), EPF (Rs.124.78 lakhs), and TDS/TCS (Rs.24.83 lakhs) with interest/damages provisions.

key_risks: Material uncertainty regarding going concern due to complete erosion of net worth and consecutive losses
Non-receipt of balance confirmations for significant outstanding balances (Advances, Trade Receivables, Trade Payables)
Non-remittance of statutory dues (ESI, EPF, TDS/TCS) with interest and damages
facts.related_party_note: The Board of Directors framed and adopted a Related Party Transaction Policy at its meeting held on October 9, 2021 and the Related Party Transaction Policy can be viewed at the Company website www.slstindia.com
